title: Laser-propelled flying-disc tests at Sandia and White Sands
place_text: Sandia National Lab and White Sands, New Mexico

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency, the US electronic spying agency, says there is a video of a test, and that he knows the man who did it. According to him, the work was done at Sandia National Lab, a US government weapons laboratory, and at White Sands, a military testing range in New Mexico, and involved taking a disc and pushing it with a laser. If true, it would show people on Earth testing flying discs driven by light.
